outcome: Expression level of galectin-7 in the syncytiotrophoblast (SCT) of the placenta
Expression level of galectin-7 in the decidua of the placenta
cohort: The study included placentas from 40 women with gestational diabetes mellitus and 40 healthy pregnant women.
finding: The study found an increased expression of galectin-7 in both the syncytiotrophoblast and the decidua of placentas from women with GDM compared to healthy pregnancies.
